statement.p: Kylie sells cars for a living. Each month, she earns {\$1{,}800.00} of base pay, plus a certain percentage of commission from her sales.
One month, Kylie made {\$71{,}300.00} in sales, and earned a total of {\$5{,}236.66} in that month (including base pay and commission). What percent commission did Kylie earn?

solution.p: Kylies pay is made up of base pay and commission. In that month, Kylie earned a total of {\$5{,}236.66}, with {\$1{,}800.00} of base pay. This implies Kylie earned {\$5{,}236.66}-{\$1{,}800.00}={\$3{,}436.66} in commission, out of {\$71{,}300.00} in sales.
